title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - PPBCInstruction
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/PPBCInstruction. An instruction for a Power Profile Based Flexibility Profile. Subclass of FlexibilityInstruction per the SAREF4ENER ontology; inherited properties are documented on the FlexibilityInstruction model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'PPBCInstruction'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

relatesToPowerProfile.description: Relationship. ID of the PPBC.PowerProfileDefinition of which the PPBC.PowerSequence is being selected and scheduled by the CEM. Relationship to PowerProfile.

relatesToPowerProfileSequence.description: Relationship. ID of the PPBC.PowerSequence that is being selected and scheduled by the CEM. Relationship to PowerSequence.

relatesToPowerProfileSequenceContainer.description: Relationship. ID of the PPBC.PowerSequnceContainer of which the PPBC.PowerSequence is being selected and scheduled by the CEM. Relationship to PowerSequenceContainer.
